description: This file contains configuration classes, extension methods, and interfaces related to persistent stream configuration within the Orleans hosting framework. It defines how clients are configured for persistent streams, including pub/sub types and lifecycle options.

classes.name: ClusterClientPersistentStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Client-side configuration provider for persistent streams, allowing configuration of pub/sub type and lifecycle options.

methods.name: ConfigureStreamPubSub
methods.description: Configures the stream pub/sub type for persistent streams.

methods.name: ConfigureLifecycle
methods.description: Configures the lifecycle options for the cluster client persistent stream.

methods.name: ClusterClientPersistentStreamConfigurator
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the client persistent stream configurator with necessary dependencies.
